summary: Iteration-2 POS design reviewed fresh against source. All 7 prior findings (1 HIGH, 4 MEDIUM, 2 NIT) are genuinely addressed and each correction was re-verified against the actual worktree code. Schema extends products additively with nullable/defaulted columns + new tables; checkout is idempotency-key + unique-index + FOR UPDATE transactional (deducts exactly once); auth reuses requireStaff/requireOwner/hasPermission + email_otps + issueTokens; the runtime-ensure*/mirrored-Prisma/manual-.sql convention is honored (no prisma migrate/db push); online storefront reads are protected by a new PUBLIC_PRODUCT_SELECT allow-list; push reuses sendToTokens/tokensForStaff/recordNotification; invoice uses the Unicode HTML path (expo-print on mobile, browser-print on web, zero new web deps); money is DECIMAL(10,2)/(12,2) and quantity DECIMAL(10,3) with integer-paise math. No native build is required. Zero HIGH and zero MEDIUM findings remain; only NITs.

findings.problem: The sequence is incremented BEFORE it is read back (UPDATE pos_next_bill_seq = pos_next_bill_seq + 1, then SELECT). With the default seed of 1, the first completed bill is numbered INV-000002, not INV-000001 — an off-by-one in the human-facing invoice number. Cosmetic only; uniqueness/collision-safety is unaffected.
findings.fix: Either seed pos_next_bill_seq = 0, or read-then-increment (SELECT the current value for the bill number, then UPDATE +1) inside the same transaction. Pick one and state it so INV-000001 is the first invoice.

findings.problem: In production (devOtp suppressed, no SMS gateway) a brand-new authorised phone that has not yet installed the app has no OTP delivery channel, because delivery relies on an already-registered FCM device. The realistic flow still works (the seeded owner 7543888698 already has devices via the existing app, and new staff install the app → register a device → then OTP push works), so acceptance (a) is not violated — but the production onboarding sequence is implicit.
findings.fix: State the production contract explicitly in §3.2: 'phone-OTP requires the authorised number to have at least one registered device; a brand-new number installs the app (registers a device) first, or the owner bootstraps via the master-password/user-login path. SMS is a documented drop-in TODO.' No code change needed, just make the sequence explicit.

findings.problem: The design asserts 'react-native-view-shot' and '@react-native-firebase/messaging' are already in mobile/package.json. Verified @notifee/react-native, expo-print, expo-sharing, expo-clipboard and @react-native-firebase/app are present; messaging and view-shot were not confirmed in the dependency spot-check. These are not load-bearing for the design's core (push reuses the existing server-side FCM infra; the invoice path uses expo-print, not view-shot), so this is accuracy hygiene only.
findings.fix: Drop the react-native-view-shot / messaging claim or confirm it against mobile/package.json; the invoice/push plan does not depend on either, so remove them from the 'already present' list if unverified to avoid an unverified assumption carried into implementation.

findings.problem: admin_phones.role is 'owner' | 'staff', but requireStaff/STAFF_ROLES only recognises user roles 'owner' | 'superadmin' | 'admin' (verified in auth/middleware.ts). §3.1 maps the OTP upsert to role = owner|admin, i.e. 'staff' → user role 'admin'. The mapping is correct but the staff→admin translation is stated only implicitly.
findings.fix: Add one sentence in §3.1: 'admin_phones.role="staff" upserts the user row with role="admin" (plus the stored permissions); role="owner" upserts role="owner". There is no distinct "staff" user role — requireStaff gates on admin+permission.'

verifiedAssumptions: issueTokens / safeUser / toClaims / isMobileClient are module-private in routes/users.ts (file only `export default router`), so the §3.1 extraction into auth/session.ts is genuinely required — confirmed by reading users.ts.

GET /api/products uses prisma.product.findMany({orderBy:{id:'asc'}}) and GET /api/products/:id uses prisma.product.findUnique with NO select — both return every column, so adding inventory fields to the Prisma Product model would leak purchase_price. The §2.1a PUBLIC_PRODUCT_SELECT fix on BOTH endpoints is correct — confirmed by reading catalog.ts.

web/src/lib/invoice.ts draws with jsPDF core helvetica, hard-codes `const rupee = 'Rs. '` ('jsPDF core fonts can't render ₹') and strips Hindi village names — so it cannot render Devanagari/₹/emoji. The iteration-1 'already renders most' claim was indeed wrong; finding 1's correction is accurate — confirmed by reading invoice.ts.
mobile/src/invoice.ts renders an expo-print HTML string with font-family 'Noto Sans' and prints ₹ directly, so the shared-HTML Unicode path is valid — confirmed by reading mobile/src/invoice.ts.

auth/middleware.ts defines requireAuth, requireOwner, requireStaff(permission) and hasPermission with owner/superadmin short-circuit and admin permission/'*' check — the RBAC reuse plan (§3) is accurate — confirmed.

services/push.ts exports sendToTokens (chunked multicast + dead-token prune), tokensForStaff(permission) (owner/superadmin + admin-with-permission), recordNotification, PushMessage and a data-only + largeIcon payload — the §7 push reuse is accurate — confirmed.

The runtime-ensure* convention exists exactly as described: ensurePlainPasswordColumn / ensureMasterPasswordColumn use information_schema COUNT guards and swallow MySQL 1060; ensureNotificationTables / ensureMarketingTables / ensureShortLinkTables use CREATE TABLE IF NOT EXISTS via $executeRawUnsafe, mirror Prisma models and have manual prisma/*.sql equivalents — confirmed in services/dataImport.ts. (Note: grep tooling does not index the .worktrees path; verified via direct file reads.)

server.ts wires these ensure* calls fire-and-forget with .catch(console.error) after seedDefaultOwner; appending the three POS ensures after ensureMarketingTables is feasible and consistent — confirmed.

settings.store_address live seed is the romanized 'Gajna Road, Chandargarh, Nabinagar, Aurangabad, Bihar - 824301' (not the Devanagari string) — finding 7's correction is accurate — confirmed in four_a_store_live.sql.

Dependencies: web/package.json has jspdf but NOT html2canvas (so §8.0's zero-new-web-dep browser-print decision is correct and the task's 'reuses jspdf+html2canvas' phrase was aspirational); api-node has multer, NOT exceljs (correctly flagged as the one new pinned backend dep); mobile has @notifee/react-native, expo-print, expo-sharing, expo-clipboard and NOT expo-document-picker (matching the §9.2 web-only-Excel platform split) — all confirmed.
The worktree HEAD (pos-billing) is at the same commit as main (880ea091), so reviewed source matches the implementation baseline.
unverifiedOrWrongAssumptions: mobile/package.json containing 'react-native-view-shot' and '@react-native-firebase/messaging' was asserted by the design but not confirmed in the spot-check (see NIT 3). Not load-bearing for the design.

The integration-level guarantees (idempotent checkout deducts stock exactly once; FOR UPDATE prevents oversell; cancel/refund restores exactly once) are design claims that read as correct and transactionally sound, but they require a live DB to prove and were NOT executed — this is a design review, not a runtime test. The §10 integration tests are the right place to confirm them.

Prisma delegate availability for the new models (prisma.posBill etc.) depends on `prisma generate` succeeding on deploy; the design flags the CDN-403 limitation and expects tsc delegate-missing errors pre-generate — not independently reproduced here.
